# HostGator
> HostGator provides web hosting, domains, website building, and related online business services for individuals and businesses.

HostGator offers shared, WordPress, VPS, dedicated, reseller, and cloud hosting alongside domain registration, email, SSL, and site management tools. Its support and knowledge base content are especially useful for operational, billing, migration, and product setup tasks.

## Main Product Pages
- [Web Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/web-hosting): Overview of shared hosting plans and core hosting features.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/wordpress-hosting): Managed and optimized hosting options for WordPress websites.
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/vps-hosting): Virtual private server hosting with scalable resources and root access.
- [Dedicated Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/dedicated-server): Dedicated server hosting for high-performance and isolated workloads.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/reseller-hosting): Hosting plans for agencies and businesses reselling hosting services.
- [Website Builder](https://www.hostgator.com/website-builder): Drag-and-drop website creation tools for small businesses and beginners.
- [Domains](https://www.hostgator.com/domains): Domain registration, transfers, and domain management services.
- [Professional Email](https://www.hostgator.com/professional-email): Business email hosting for branded communication and mailbox management.

## Support Center
- [Support Portal](https://www.hostgator.com/help): Central support entry point for product, billing, and account help.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article): Searchable help articles covering setup, troubleshooting, and account management.
- [System Status](https://status.hostgator.com/): Service status and incident updates for HostGator systems.
- [Contact Support](https://www.hostgator.com/contact): Support contact options for sales, billing, and technical issues.
- [Forums](https://forums.hostgator.com/): Community discussions and peer support for hosting-related topics.

## Getting Started Guides
- [Getting Started](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/getting-started): Introductory help content for new hosting customers.
- [How to Point a Domain to HostGator](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-change-my-dns-or-name-servers): Instructions for updating nameservers and DNS to use HostGator hosting.
- [How to Log in to cPanel](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-log-into-cpanel): Steps for accessing cPanel to manage hosting settings.
- [How to Upload a Website](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-upload-my-site): Basic guidance for publishing website files to hosting.
- [How to Create Email Accounts](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-create-an-email-account): Setup instructions for creating and managing hosted email accounts.
- [How to Install WordPress](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-install-wordpress): WordPress installation guidance using HostGator tools and hosting environments.

- [Account Backups](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/backups): Information about backups, restoration, and backup-related limitations.

## Domains and DNS
- [Domain Registration](https://www.hostgator.com/domains): Register new domains and manage domain-related services.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.hostgator.com/domains/transfer): Transfer an existing domain to HostGator.
- [DNS Management Help](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/dns-management): Guidance for editing DNS records and zone settings.
- [Nameserver Changes](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-change-my-dns-or-name-servers): Update nameservers to connect domains with HostGator hosting.
- [Addon Domains](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-create-an-addon-domain): Instructions for adding and managing addon domains in cPanel.
- [Subdomains](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-create-a-subdomain): Steps for creating subdomains for hosted websites and applications.

## WordPress and CMS
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/wordpress-hosting): Hosting plans tailored for WordPress performance and ease of use.
- [Install WordPress](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-install-wordpress): Setup instructions for deploying WordPress on HostGator hosting.

- [Migrate a WordPress Site](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/wordpress-migration): Help for moving an existing WordPress site to HostGator.
- [Softaculous / One-Click Installs](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/softaculous): Application installer guidance for WordPress and other CMS platforms.

## Security and SSL
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.hostgator.com/ssl-certificates): SSL options for securing websites and enabling HTTPS.
- [Install an SSL Certificate](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-install-an-ssl-certificate): Instructions for installing SSL on hosted domains.
- [Force HTTPS](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-to-force-https-using-the-htaccess-file): Redirect site traffic to HTTPS using .htaccess rules.
- [Site Security](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/security): General security guidance for protecting hosting accounts and websites.
- [CodeGuard](https://www.hostgator.com/codeguard): Website backup and monitoring service for recovery and protection.
- [SiteLock](https://www.hostgator.com/sitelock): Website security scanning and malware protection services.

## Developer and Advanced Hosting
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.hostgator.com/vps-hosting): Scalable virtual servers for custom stacks and advanced administration.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.hostgator.com/dedicated-server): Bare-metal hosting for high-demand applications and workloads.
- [SSH Access](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/ssh-access): Guidance for enabling and using SSH on supported hosting plans.
- [Cron Jobs](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-set-up-a-cron-job): Instructions for scheduling recurring tasks in cPanel.
- [FTP Accounts](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-create-an-ftp-account): Create and manage FTP users for file transfers.
- [PHP Configuration](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/php-configuration): Information on PHP settings and version management.
- [MySQL Databases](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-do-i-create-a-mysql-database): Steps for creating and managing MySQL databases.
